title: Implement Akinfiev-Diamond EoS and water property interface
action: Implement the Akinfiev-Diamond (2003) equation of state for aqueous nonelectrolytes at infinite dilution: chemical potential, Henry's constant, vapour-liquid distribution constant, partial molar volume, partial molar heat capacity, and Krichevskii parameter. Write Python functions that use the EoS parameters (ξ, a, b) and the ideal-gas properties (ΔfG°₂₉₈, S°₂₉₈, Cₚ(T) function). Implement a water property helper that retrieves pure-water density, fugacity, and needed derivatives along the saturation curve and at specified P,T using the IAPWS IF97 model via the `iapws` package.
description: Required process step: implement the thermodynamic model and water property interface.

title: Compute vapour-liquid distribution constants ln KD
action: Using the EoS and water properties along the saturation curve, compute ln K_D for B(OH)₃ (ξ=-1.057, a=-4.2561 cm³ g⁻¹, b=4.0194 cm³ K^0.5 g⁻¹) at temperatures 373.15 K, 500 K, 520 K, 573 K, and 623 K. Write the results to a CSV file.
description: Predicted ln K_D values for B(OH)₃ along the water saturation curve.
output_schema: Columns: Temp_K (temperature in K), ln_KD (dimensionless natural logarithm of the distribution constant). One row per temperature.

title: Compute partial molar volume and heat capacity
action: Using the EoS and water properties, compute the partial molar volume V2∞ (cm³ mol⁻¹) and partial molar heat capacity Cp2∞ (J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹) for B(OH)₃ (ξ=-1.057, a=-4.2561, b=4.0194) at temperatures 298, 350, 400, 450, 500 K for pressures 28 MPa and 35 MPa. Write the results to a CSV file.
description: Predicted partial molar volumes and heat capacities for B(OH)₃ at specified isobars.
output_schema: Columns: Temp_K (temperature in K), Pressure_MPa (pressure in MPa), V2infty_cm3_mol (partial molar volume in cm³ mol⁻¹), Cp2infty_J_mol_K (partial molar heat capacity in J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹). One row per (T,P) combination.

title: Compute Krichevskii parameter and standard-state properties
action: Compute the Krichevskii parameter A_Kr (MPa) for B(OH)₃ (ξ=-1.057, a=-4.2561, b=4.0194) using the EoS parameters and the critical constants of water (from IAPWS). Compute the standard-state Gibbs free energy of formation ΔfG∞ (kJ mol⁻¹) and standard-state entropy S₂° (J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹) for aqueous B(OH)₃ at 298.15 K and 0.1 MPa using the ideal-gas properties (ΔfG°₂₉₈ = -931.04 kJ mol⁻¹, S°₂₉₈ = 278.61 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹, Cₚ(T) function) and the EoS. Write the results to a JSON file.
description: Derived thermodynamic constants (Krichevskii parameter and standard‑state aqueous properties) for B(OH)₃.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: A_Kr_MPa (number, MPa), delta_f_G_infinity_kJ_mol (number, kJ mol⁻¹), S2_infinity_J_mol_K (number, J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹).
